API for detecting equivocation and building, verifying, and chunking duplicate-shred proofs.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_eqvoc` interface for detecting, storing, and verifying equivocation proofs for shreds in a slot-based ledger. It groups the logic into FEC set metadata handling through `fd_eqvoc_fec` and duplicate-shred proof handling through `fd_eqvoc_proof`, with pools and maps used to index entries by slot and related keys. The file also defines the memory layout, size limits, and chunking rules used to serialize and reconstruct duplicate-shred gossip messages. In addition, it provides APIs to initialize the module, query and insert records, verify shred conflicts, and check that FEC sets chain correctly across a slot.
